body:
Two source fixes that restore building duckdb with MSVC (`cl`). CI no longer builds with `cl`, so nothing catches these.

- `TYPE_COUNT` in `src/common/types.cpp` becomes `static constexpr`, so the lambda can use it without a capture (C3493).
- The C++ API test target gets `/Zc:strictStrings` under MSVC. Without it `cl` converts a string literal to `void*` and `Instance(":memory:")` picks the private `Instance(void*)` constructor in `duckdb_cpp.hpp` (C2248).
- No behaviour change for the clang builds that ship: the flag is applied only when the compiler ID is `MSVC`, and only to the test target.

`/Zc:strictStrings` is a test-side workaround. Users of `duckdb_cpp.hpp` who build with `cl` hit the same error, so the `Instance(void*)` overload deserves a fix in the header, which I left to the API owners.
title: Fix MSVC source compatibility: constexpr lambda capture and strict string literals
